verdict.rationale: Salv documents that auto-closed alerts from clearance rules remain on the record as an audit trail, which covers automated decisions. Cases carry notes, documents, an assignee and a status, which implies a record of human work but not a decision history. Nothing shows timestamps, a unified human-plus-automated decision log, or a way to retrieve or export it. Missing for 10: explicit timestamped decision log, documented audit trail of human case decisions (who/when changed status), retrieval/export of the audit trail via UI or API, independent corroboration.
